授業概要
教育研究を人間形成の研究としてリ・デザインする方向性で，教育実践に関する事例研究（ケーススタディ）について、関係諸論文の講読や実際の教育実践事例の分析・考察を行う。
In order to redesign educational research as research on human formation, we will read subscripts on domestic and international related papers and analyze and discuss practical examples of practical education on case studies (case studies, case methods) on educational practice. Also, if possible, we will conduct participant observation at the school (Elementary school in Itoshima) and discuss based on it.
